items.title: Your Nvidia Weight Sets How Much A Fall Hurts
items.summary: Nvidia closed at $150.96 on Wednesday, Nov 18. That is 36.9% below its record close of $239.24 on Oct 6. Wednesday's 2.9% drop came the day after Nvidia's third-quarter report. Revenue rose 103% from a year earlier, to $115.8 billion.
